name: power-app-dataverse-codex-plugin
description: Enterprise guidance skills for designing conversational Dataverse and Power Apps action workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Design governed AI action workflows for Dataverse and Power Apps.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for shaping Dataverse and Power Apps into a conversational enterprise execution platform. It covers the PRD vision: universal natural-language actions, intent-to-action mapping, autonomous workflow orchestration, context-aware Dataverse AI, conversational ERP/CRM, generated task UI, multi-agent operating models, data operations, organizational memory, voice-first operations, action marketplace design, universal command bar patterns, predictive action intelligence, safety governance, explainable actions, end-user-first UX, and strategic differentiation. It also includes a real stdio MCP server for Microsoft Dataverse Web API access through OAuth2 client credentials. Write tools are gated by DATAVERSE_ALLOW_WRITES=true and explicit per-call confirmation.
capabilities: Live Dataverse MCP tools with OAuth
defaultPrompt: Design a Dataverse AI action workflow.
Review this Power Apps solution for ALM readiness.
Assess governance risks for this Dataverse action.
